Lore: Relic Lenses

Netherese reading glasses, found in the captains' quarters of the Id Ascendant. It has the following Powers:

  • Minute Seeing: The wearer has Favor on Checks to examine anything within 1 foot.

Value: 500g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
